items.label: USAO-MA civil: The Herb Chambers Companies
items.detail: False Claims Act settlement over eight Chambers-owned companies' Paycheck Protection Program loans, which the SBA's $20 million cap for one corporate group made them ineligible for; date is the announcement date. The release states 'Herbert G. Chambers, several of his companies and James Duchesneau, one of the companies' Officers, have agreed to pay approximately $11.8 million' with no split between the companies and the two individuals, so the row stays in gross and counts for no company (shared total, split not stated). The release does not name the eight companies. Admitted in the settlement agreement: the eight companies had applied for the loans before the cap rule and reapplied through a second bank. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-usao-ma-2025-herb-chambers; listed under Amounts not counted).
